summary.text: Estela Reyes is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 4th Essex District since January 2023 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Reyes took office on January 4, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, she was assigned to the Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, State Administration and Regulatory Oversight, and Veterans and Federal Affairs joint committees, and served as vice chair of the Joint Committee on Emergency Preparedness and Management.
